gap: No result ChatGPT got states what any of these kits costs today: eufy's own US store has the Video Doorbell E340 + Smart Display E10 bundle at $419.99 (not the $399.98 ChatGPT showed), against $149.99 for the SwitchBot Smart Video Doorbell on SwitchBot's US store, a $270 gap for an 8-inch versus a 4.3-inch indoor screen.
standout_why: The cited Smart Home Perfected page (6 picks, read 2026-11-10) gives no price for any product; it has only 'Check Price On Amazon' links, and it does not give the E10's screen size. WorthRated (top result in both chats) gives no dollar figures, only 'priced toward the lower end' or 'premium pick', with no date checked. ChatGPT's own cards priced only eufy ($399.98, now stale) and the wired kits. None of them prices SwitchBot or puts the wireless kits side by side.
decides: It confirms that the two wireless kits ChatGPT showed split on price, not just on screen: eufy at $419.99 buys an 8-inch 1280x800 display with 64 GB internal storage, and SwitchBot at $149.99 (plus $69.99 per extra monitor) is the budget pick if a 4.3-inch screen will do. eufy's price on its own store also went up by $20.01 from what ChatGPT showed. Our own AOSU doorbells ($95.99 and $135.99) don't belong in this answer because their listings name no indoor display.
